summary: Takagi/Steinitz source-hunt and corpus-audit packet. This package does not add promoted reader coverage. It corrects local status: Steinitz 1914 Bedingt II is complete in the current working packets, 1916 Bedingt III is the active continuation through p.13 with p.14 next, and the formerly unresolved Steinitz 1908 Analysis Situs source gap is now partially closed by a 22-page 300-ppi Ranicki offprint witness. Takagi remains intake-only: local UTokyo witnesses cover 1903, 1920, and 1922, but are effectively about 400 ppi, while the existing Takagi aid PNGs are locator-only.
